configuration.data:
kind: AdaptiveDialog
beginDialog:
  kind: OnActivity
  id: main
  condition: =!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVTableContext)
  priority: 0
  actions:
    - kind: ParseValue
      id: AWiNoo
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_DVTableContext_Version
      valueType: String
      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVTableContext_Version), Text(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVTableContext_Version), "-1")

    - kind: ParseValue
      id: UQYj77
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_DVTableContext
      valueType:
        kind: Table
        properties:
          SpanValue: String
          tableLogicalName: String

      value: =Text(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVTableContext)
configuration.description: This topic returns the table data back to copilot control
configuration.name: AppCopilot DV Table Context
